description: This file is an HTML webpage for a Database Viewer application, featuring UI layout, styling, and frontend logic for interacting with a database visualization backend.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the database list, updating the UI and resetting selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database entries in the sidebar, loading tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders table data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Dynamically generates the HTML for displaying data in a table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling different data types and sizes.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for large or object data.
